Config Snippet: line vty 0 4
 transport input none
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 transport input none

Control: Disable plaintext Telnet administration (CIS-2.1.1)
Config Snippet: line vty 0 4
 transport input all
 login local

Control: Disable plaintext Telnet administration (CIS-2.1.1)
Config Snippet: line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 transport input telnet ssh

Control: Disable plaintext Telnet administration (CIS-2.1.1)
Config Snippet: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh max-pre-authentication-packets 4
set system login message "Authorized users only"

Control: Disable plaintext Telnet administration (CIS-2.1.1)
Config Snippet: config system interface
 edit "mgmt_vlan"
 set allowaccess ping https telnet
 next
end

Control: Unset default SNMP community strings (CIS-1.3.1)
Config Snippet: snmp-server community public-monitoring RO 15
snmp-server community private-admin RW 20

Control: Unset default SNMP community strings (CIS-1.3.1)
Config Snippet: snmp-server group SECURE_V3 v3 priv
snmp-server user secadmin SECURE_V3 v3 auth sha <REDACTED> priv aes 128 <REDACTED>

Control: Enforce modern cryptographic algorithms (CIS-4.1.2)
Config Snippet: crypto ipsec transform-set HYBRID esp-aes 256 esp-3des esp-sha-hmac

Control: Enforce modern cryptographic algorithms (CIS-4.1.2)
Config Snippet: crypto ipsec profile SUITE-B
 set transform-set ESP-GCM-256
 set pfs group19

Control: Restrict any-to-any firewall rules (CIS-3.1.4)
Config Snippet: ip access-list extended INBOUND-EDGE
 10 permit tcp any any established
 20 permit udp host 10.1.1.1 host 10.2.2.2 eq 53
 30 deny ip any any log

Control: Restrict any-to-any firewall rules (CIS-3.1.4)
Config Snippet: ip access-list extended RESTRICTED-WEB
 10 permit ip any any
 20 deny ip any any

Control: Configure remote audit logging (CIS-1.4.1)
Config Snippet: logging buffered 16000
no logging host
logging source-interface Loopback0

Control: Configure remote audit logging (CIS-1.4.1)
Config Snippet: logging host 10.100.1.50
logging host 10.100.1.51
logging trap informational
logging facility local7

Control: Configure authoritative NTP time sources (CIS-1.4.2)
Config Snippet: /system ntp client set enabled=no primary-ntp=10.1.1.1 secondary-ntp=10.1.1.2

Control: Configure remote audit logging (CIS-1.4.1)
Config Snippet: info-center enable
info-center loghost 10.10.50.1 facility local5
info-center loghost source-ip 10.10.50.254

Control: Configure remote audit logging (CIS-1.4.1)
Config Snippet: configure log syslog 1 address 192.168.100.50
configure log log-id 100 to syslog 1
